title: Raytheon Secures US Navy Agreement to Advance Nuclear-Armed Cruise Missile Programme

The agreement marks the transition from preliminary concept work to a more focused development phase, with Raytheon’s Advanced Technology division responsible for progressing the programme towards future prototype demonstrations.
